name: Xperia ZR

images.credit: y nk9w, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Sony Xperia Z1 Compact, Sony Xperia Z1 f (Japan)

Network.Technology: UMTS HSPA+ 900 (Band VIII), 2100 (Band I) Mhz (not available in all markets), UMTS HSPA+ 850 (Band V), 1700 (Band IV), 1900 (Band II), 2100 (Band I) (not available in all markets) GSM GPRS/EDGE 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz

Body.Other: Available in black, pink, cyan and white (Mint is exclusive to SO-04E/Xperia A, while Miku is exclusive to Xperia feat. Hatsune Miku), IP55 / IP58 (Dust protected, Water jet protected & Waterproof), Osaifu-Keitai (SO-04E/Xperia A and Xperia feat. Hatsune Miku variants only), 1seg (SO-04E/Xperia A and Xperia feat. Hatsune Miku variants only), NOTTV (SO-04E/Xperia A and Xperia feat. Hatsune Miku variants only), POBox Touch 6.1 (SO-04E/Xperia A and Xperia feat. Hatsune Miku variants only)

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.1.2 "Jelly Bean" (initial), Android 4.2.2 "Jelly Bean" (2013 upgrade), Android 4.3 "Jelly Bean" (Dec 2013 upgrade), Android 4.4 "KitKat" (June 2014 upgrade), Android 5.0.2 "Lollipop", Android 5.1.1 "Lollipop" (current, depend on location)
Platform.Chipset: Qualcomm® Snapdragon™ S4 Pro APQ8064 processor / Qualcomm® Snapdragon™ 600 processor

Memory.Card slot: up to 32 GB microSDHC (officially), up to 64 GB microSDXC (unofficially)

Display.Display: 4.55 in diagonal TFT, 1280x720 px (~323 ppi) and Sony BRAVIA Engine 2 with scratch-resistant and shatterproof glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 13 MP IMX135 Exmor RS back-side illuminated sensor with LED flash, 1080p video recording @ 30 frames/s 16x Digital Zoom

Battery.Battery: 2,330 mAh 13 hours talk time, 520 standby, removable

Connectivity.Connectivity: 4G LTE(100 Mbit/s) LTE (Bands 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 20), GPS, GLONASS, Micro USB 2.0, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC, UMTS HSPA+ (Bands 1, 3, 5, 8 or bands 1, 2, 4, 5, 8), Wi-Fi (802.11 a/b/g/n), DLNA, GSM GPRS/EDGE 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz, MHL

key.chipset: Qualcomm® Snapdragon™ S4 Pro APQ8064 processor / Qualcomm® S
